promises.quote: HEE will work with key partners, including the RCR, to ensure that the NHS has available the right number of trained staff to deliver the current and future demand for diagnostic tests.

concerns.quote: There was a delay of 5 days in the formal reporting of the original X-ray
concerns.hazard: delay in formal reporting of original X-ray

concerns.quote: There was a further delay of 2 to 3 days in the obtaining of a second X-ray

The Consultant responsible for Mr [name redacted] care did not know of Hospital guidance that an MRI should be obtained where a first X-ray is inconclusive and/or the patient complains of pain or fails to mobilise
concerns.hazard: lack of knowledge of MRI guidance

reports.title: Claire Twinn: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Ms [name redacted] disability played a role in the provision of sub-optimal care, reasonable adjustment was not made for; her inability to communicate clearly and her impaired respiratory function when arriving at clinical decisions.

Neither the trust decision to discharge Ms Twinn and not admit for continued monitoring of oxygen levels and remedial oxygen therapy, nor clear safety-netting advice to carers was recorded in the clinical record.
A radiological report of the chest x-ray taken on 15th December 2023 was not reported until 25th December 2023.

links.explanation: Both reports highlight a significant delay in the reporting of radiological imaging results. The core issue is the untimely communication of X-ray findings to clinicians.
